theorems.name: Submission.slicing_mb_cdb_multiplier_integral_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Eucl P)) (F : Eucl P → ℝ) (K : Set (Eucl P)) (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (g : ℕ → Eucl P → ℝ) (χ : ℝ → ℝ), Integrable F ν → (∀ x, x ∉ K → F x = 0) → (∀ j, Measurable (g j)) → (∀ x ∈ K, Tendsto (fun j => g j x) atTop (𝓝 (f x))) → Continuous χ → (∀ s, |χ s| ≤ 1) → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, χ (g j x) * F x ∂ν) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, χ (f x) * F x ∂ν))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
